Head over here to sign up for Rakuten (formerly Ebates) and get a $50 bonus after your first $50+ purchase! This is the BIGGEST bonus I've ever seen them do, and it's on top of the fantastic cash back you'll get for shopping online through them! How it works...you sign up for Rakuten here and search for the store you want to shop at (Nordstrom, Sephora, CVS, Shein, Instacart, Priceline, and literally thousands of other sites). You'll click "shop now" and you'll automatically get the cash back percentage listed on the Rakuten site once you place your order. Basically, Rakuten is acting like an ad network. Think of it this way...when you click on a Nordstrom ad on a website you're reading, Nordstrom pays the referring website a fee. When you shop through Rakuten first, the stores pay a referral fee directly to Rakuten...their business model is that they share the fees with you (you'll get a check a few times a year).
Let's walk through an example of exactly how to save (we'll use Instacart as an example). I would sign up for Rakuten here (or log in to my account if I already have one). Then I would search for "Instacart" and click "Shop Now." If I made a $50 purchase (and was new) I would get $1 cash back into my account (since they're currently paying 2%) PLUS the $50 sign-up bonus. It might not seem like a lot, but if you shop at Instacart every week, the extra percentage back will add up!
Here's another example with Sephora. Log into Rakuten here, search for "Sephora" then click "shop now" to get 10% back (the percentage can vary from day to day)! If you spent $100, you'd get $10 back in your Rakuten account automatically (plus the $50 bonus if you're new).
I've seen up to 25% back or even more when they're doing promotions...and that's ON TOP of any coupon codes or sales!
If you're an online shopper like me, you'll be amazed at how much money you get back, especially with the holiday season coming up! It's another money-saving habit to start up...go through Rakuten before you buy. I've heard from so many people who are bummed they haven't been doing this for years! I've never had a reader sign up and not love it (that I've heard of).
This is truly one of my FAVORITE ways to save!
E-mail me with any questions (alicia@dealsinaz.com) and enjoy!

posts.title: Check If You Have Unclaimed Property (Usually $$$) at the AZ Dept. of Revenue! I Did and I'm Shocked!
posts.excerpt: If you're in the mood for a quick, free treasure hunt that benefits YOU, this is 100% worth it! Head over here to get to the Arizona Department of Revenue…
posts.text:
If you're in the mood for a quick, free treasure hunt that benefits YOU, this is 100% worth it! Head over here to get to the Arizona Department of Revenue website and search for unclaimed property with your name or business name. It takes seconds and could be a rent deposit, an old account you forgot about, or something else!
In my case, I started thinking about a very small (25+ year old) IRA account I opened before I was married (I did some digging and found out the account was sold to a different bank, and the new bank had a typo in my address). I searched the AZ Department of Revenue site and found it (I was shocked). I filled out the claim form and it was approved...it was an easy process! I can't wait to see what shows up. I'm sharing this story with you because everyone should interact with accounts at least yearly to ensure they don't go dormant (and check out the AZDOR site here). My old account DID go dormant when I left it alone (and since I wasn't getting statements because of the typo in the address, I didn't think about it).
My husband had unclaimed property as well! I talked to my hairdresser about it yesterday, and she found five unclaimed things for people close to her! This prompted me to share it with you!
There are literally BILLIONS of dollars of unclaimed property waiting for rightful owners in AZ. I can't wait to hear that some of it belongs to you (please keep me posted)!
Check out the AZ Department of Revenue's latest press release regarding Unclaimed Property on their website...
"ADOR Returns a Record $88 Million in Unclaimed Property during Fiscal Year 2024 | 07/30/2024
PHOENIX–The Arizona Department of Revenue’s (ADOR) Unclaimed Property program returned a record $88 million to rightful owners in fiscal year 2024 (July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024), significantly higher than the recent 5-year average of $57 million per year. Amounts given back to owners ranged from $1.0 to $1.5 million.“ADOR’s Unclaimed Property team is dedicated to their mission of reuniting owners with their property and their incredible efforts have resulted in an all-time record amount of property returned this last fiscal year,” said Rebecca Wilder, Communications Director for the Arizona Department of Revenue. “We’d like to ask for the public’s help to return even more. ADOR encourages everyone to search their name at https://azdor.gov/unclaimed-property or MissingMoney.com, and to search every few years in the event any property has been reported.”Unclaimed property generally consists of money due to an individual or business from sources such as old bank accounts, uncashed payroll checks, tax refunds, credit balances, rebates, returned deposits, and dormant safe deposit boxes. Often property becomes unclaimed because the company that holds the funds has an outdated address or the wrong forwarding address for the customer. In some cases, a person passes away with no family members aware of the assets. Most accounts are turned over to the state after years of inactivity. The Arizona Department of Revenue Unclaimed Property Unit collects, safeguards, and aims to reunite unclaimed property with its rightful owner. Each year, the agency sends out thousands of notices to potential property owners, promotes the program through Arizona media, and works with other state agencies in Arizona and across the country to track unclaimed property owners. For more information on the Arizona Department of Revenue’s Unclaimed Property program, customers can go to https://azdor.gov/unclaimed-property."
Happy Friday!
Enjoy!

Disney’s Mary Poppins
Mary Poppins lands on the doorstep of Number Seventeen Cherry Tree Lane right in time to save the Banks family from a nannyless day. posts.title: Check Out FREE Spay and Neuter Weekend This Saturday and Sunday!
posts.excerpt: If you have a dog or cat you haven't had fixed yet, check this out! It's FREE spay and neuter weekend at locations all over Phoenix, Avondale, and Mesa. This…
posts.text:
If you have a dog or cat you haven't had fixed yet, check this out! It's FREE spay and neuter weekend at locations all over Phoenix, Avondale, and Mesa. This can save you hundreds of dollars! Here's all the details:
"Age and Weight Requirements for Surgery:
All pets must be between 3lbs weight and 60lbs weight.
No pets 5 years of age or older
Limit of 2 pets per household
Event & Pre-Surgery Instructions
Check-in will begin at 7am. First-come, first-served
Space is limited. Availability and kennel space based on sex, species, weight & size of animals
Free vaccinations will be provided with the surgery only
Vaccination will include a Rabies Vaccine & 4-in-1 for dogs (aka-Parvo/Distemper combo) or 3-in-1 for cats (FVRCP)
All animals must be in good health
All animals must be friendly
All dogs must be on a leash
All cats must be in a secure carrier (1 per carrier)
NO FOOD AFTER 10PM THE NIGHT BEFORE SURGERY
Water is fine up until you leave your house for the surgery
No pets that are in-heat, pregnant, obese or cryptorchid, please
No feral cats or rescue organizations, please
Maricopa County residents, only
PICK-UP & Post-Surgery: You will be advised by each veterinary team as to when your designated time for pick-up will be. Please do not travel too far from your location, as they may call to advise you that your animal is ready for pick-up earlier than first stated. *Though intake (obtaining a spot for this event) is based on a first-come, first-serve process, surgeries are not. Surgeries are performed in an order based on a variety of factors.
​
General Event Rules:
Lines will begin to form OUTDOORS very early at each location
Please come prepared for the weather & wait time; bringing water for you and your pet(s), warm clothing and easy to carry chair if needed.
Please have patience and be courteous to your fellow neighbor in line and their pet(s), event staff & volunteers.
Fix.Adopt.Save. representatives will be managing the lines as well as working alongside the veterinary staff during check-in. Please be sure you have read the details regarding the limit of space.
Fix.Adopt.Save. representatives will be wearing light-blue t-shirts with the FAS logo
We ask that you please not contact the participating organizations/clinics prior to the event as complete event details are listed within this page. We thank you for your understanding.
​
Location notes:
Avondale Civic Center Library: 11350 Civic Center Dr., Avondale 85323
Located south of I-10 on Avondale Blvd. East-end of center
The line will begin in front of library and wrap around the side of the building
Two surgical spay/neuter mobile units will be providing services
Altered Tails Barnhart Clinic Phoenix:
950 W Hatcher Rd, Phoenix 85021
Entrance is located off of 11th Avenue & Hatcher Rd.
Arizona Humane Society, Spay/Neuter Clinic- Phoenix:
1311 W Hatcher Rd, Phoenix 85021
Arizona Humane Society, Spay/Neuter Clinic- South Mountain Campus for Compassion:
1521 W Dobbins Rd, Phoenix 85041
Altered Tails Barnhart Clinic Mesa: 7246 East Main St, Suite #3, Mesa 85207
This location will provide surgeries through Altered Tails and a surgical spay/neuter mobile unit as well.
We are EXCITED to be offering this amazing, one-time, event to our communities and their pets. We look forward to assisting you and working together to end pet homelessness in the Valley."
Thanks so much Jen!

posts.title: Huge Savings on Biosphere 2 Tickets!
posts.excerpt: If you're looking for some fun, educational experiences this summer, head over here to save big on Biosphere 2 tickets. Use code EPIC3 to get an extra 20% off…
posts.text:
If you're looking for some fun, educational experiences this summer, head over here to save big on Biosphere 2 tickets. Use code EPIC3 to get an extra 20% off (through Tuesday)! Two people will pay $20.80 instead of $51 with the code!
"In 1984, Space Biospheres Ventures purchased a few unassuming acres north of Tucson in the shadow the Santa Catalina Mountains. There, the company expanded its sci-fi-sounding activities—the development of space-colonization technology—and built what would evolve into Biosphere 2, recently seen on The Today Show.
Designed to re-create Earth's ecosystems, the gigantic glass enclosure (some 7.2 million cubic feet and 91 feet tall in some parts) is famous for housing biospherians in the 1990s. The researchers lived completely sealed inside for extended periods, giving scientists groundbreaking data on human survivability and interaction with particular bionetworks.
The University of Arizona had the 40-acre Biosphere 2 campus donated in 2011, maintaining it as a hub of serious research while expanding its mission to encompass interactive educational outreach. Each year, thousands pass through the on-site labs and classrooms as well as stroll the Biosphere 2 interior to view films, experience multimedia exhibits, or embark on guided tours. Tours venture into the actual ecosystems, allowing earthlings to note biodiversity, smell fresh precipitation in the rain forest, and savor the softness of savannah grassland underfoot until the resident grumpy old man yells at you to get the heck off his lawn. Before their dramatic conclusion at a million-gallon ocean tank, tours delve into the basement to explore the technosphere, where visitors can witness the deep inhales and exhales of the sphere’s respiratory system."
Enjoy!

posts.title: Chipotle Shared Their Guacamole Recipe...For Free!
posts.excerpt: Love Chipotle guacamole? You're in luck! I was so excited to see that they SHARED their recipe on their facebook page!
posts.text:
Love Chipotle guacamole? You're in luck! I was so excited to see that they SHARED their recipe on their facebook page!
"Ingredients:
2 ripe Hass avocados
2 tsp lime juice
2 tbsp cilantro (chopped)
1/4 cup red onion (finely chopped)
1/2 jalapeño, including seeds (finely chopped)
1/4 tsp kosher salt
1. Choose the right avocado: squishy yet firm with a nice dark green color on the inside.
2. Cut the avocado in half and remove the pit.
3. Scoop the avocados and place in a medium-sized bowl.
4. Toss and coat with lime juice.
5. Add the salt and using a fork or potato masher, mash until a smooth consistency.
6. Fold in the remaining ingredients and mix well.
7. Taste the guacamole; adjust seasoning if necessary."
Another Chipotle tip: I always get a single taco (it's way less expensive and won't completely kill your diet). Bonus: It's only $.75 to add guacamole to a single taco (if they look at you like you're nuts tell them there IS a single taco guacamole add button on the register)!
:-)

"No one goes thirsty at The Great Arizona Beer Festival, thanks to the sheer quantity of beer that abounds across the festival grounds. This year, more than 50 breweries from across Arizona, the U.S., and the Milky Way come together to share 200+ craft beers. posts.excerpt: Do you love cheese? This has to be one of the most fun posts I've done. Albertsons asked me to put together a cheese board with some of their beautiful…
posts.text:
Do you love cheese? This has to be one of the most fun posts I've done. Albertsons asked me to put together a cheese board with some of their beautiful ingredients (it took me literally less than half a second to say yes). To make the project even sweeter, they gave me a cheese basket to give away to one lucky reader (see details below, retail value around $100)!
Lucky for us, ALL specialty cheeses at Albertsons will be going on sale soon!
Here's what I picked up for our board (I like sweet/savory and crunchy/creamy contrast):
Hoffman's Natural Vermont Cheddar Cheese
Monet Mini Original water crackers
Dietz and Watson Mini Salame
Roasted almonds
Dried apricots
Primizie Handmade snack crisps
Kalamata olives (from the olive bar)
Dietz and Watson Salame Panino (hot salame rolled in mozzarella cheese..pretty and so good)
La Bonne Vie Triple Creme Brie
Savannah Bee Co. Honey for Cheese
Raspberries
To make the baked brie I preheated the oven to 350 degrees. I put the brie on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper and drizzled it with the Savannah Bee Co. honey for cheese (I remember when Ina Garten put brie with honey and have loved it ever since). I would definitely recommend this honey, it really added a nice flavor to the baked brie. I baked for around 7-8 minutes and plated it with raspberries on top (SO EASY even I could do it). It was absolutely DELICIOUS with the Primizie handmade crisp breads.
The board with the cheddar, mozzarella, apricots, olives, water crackers, and salame was really easy to put together too. It made for a wonderful Friday night dinner with a glass of wine.
A nice cheese board is one of the easiest things to make (there is no cooking ability required), and can make a huge impression on your guests.
Here's how you can enter to win a cheese basket worth around $100 from Albertsons (cheese lovers will DEFINITELY want to apply):
1. Build your perfect cheese board
2. Take a picture and post it on the Alicia's Deals facebook page or on Twitter (please tag #aliciasdeals).
I'll pick a winner on November 26th.
Enjoy and I can't wait to see what you can do with cheese!
We are all going to have beautiful starters this holiday season. :-)

posts.excerpt: In case you missed any of the 3TV segments, I thought I'd put them all in one spot. When you keep these tips in mind, you'll save a SIGNIFICANT amount of…
posts.text:
In case you missed any of the 3TV segments, I thought I'd put them all in one spot. When you keep these tips in mind, you'll save a SIGNIFICANT amount of money! Who wants to pay more than they have to? Knowledge is power! :-)
Taken from AZfamily.com:
"PHOENIX -- Most people have a favorite store. Whether it's the store closest to your, the one that's on the way home from work or simply the one that always has exactly what you want, chances are you have "your" store.
Deals Diva Alicia Markham explains how you can save money at your store, even when the items you want are not on sale.
Monday -- Ad matching at Wal-Mart
Tuesday -- Safeway's Just 4 U app is your best money-saving friend
Wednesday -- 5 tips to save money at Fry's
Thursday -- How to sae more when you shop at CVS
Friday -- 4 tips to save a ton at Target
Deals Diva Alicia Markham has one goal -- to help you live life better for less.
"I only post deals I truly love and would buy or participate in myself," she says.
A stay-at-home mom of two, Markham describes herself as frugal and says she is passionate about saving money. She wants to help you hang on to your hard-earned dollars, too.
"I think it's so important to save without sacrificing your quality of life," she says.
Markham's blog won Phoenix Magazine's Best of the Valley recognition in 2011, 2012, and 2013 and Arizona Foothill's Magazine's Best of Our Valley recognition in 2014.
If there's a deal to be had, Markham will find it and share it with you.
Website: DealsInAZ.com
Facebook: Alicia's Deals (Facebook.com/aliciasdeals)
Twitter: @aliciasdeals
Email: alicia@dealsinaz.com"
